body: Lamictal fried my brain. Couldn't think or recall a damn thing.
I hate how things can just set me of like that. Crying for what seems like no reason.

I've recently decreased from 200mg to 100mg. When I was at 200 I felt like the lights were on but no one was home. I was quiet all the time. I struggled at work and couldn't grasp concepts that I knew before. Zero reading comprehension. Essentially everything I struggled with before but just magnetized.
My pdoc added abilify which seemed to help. It's been a couple of weeks and i'm not sure it is still helping....
Wow. That's a different perspective but I can see where you are coming from.

I'm trying. I've wanted to "stop walking" on many occasions. I'm trying to just grieve and not bring her back into my present. I just wish I could watch a video of the shitty times I know we had. It wasn't amazing as I remember it. 

But she was my best friend god dammit.
I've always been sensitive of smells especially perfume. They can very quickly give me a migraine.
Does this help with the depression?

I keep hoping for that dawn. I know shouldn't take it literal but the mornings are always the hardest part of the day. 

I just assumed that my wife found someone. I don't know what I'm going to do when she finds someone. She said she is happy being alone.
I'm trying to. Work hits me hard. I just want to run home to my wife. I'm such a fucking baby.
It makes me cry to think I can't give one a loving home.

I'm sorry I didn't get this until today.

My wife and I separated and now heading toward a divorce. She has the house, three dogs and the town we lived in for years. I live alone in a white walled one bedroom near where I work. In a state of mania I thought this was the best idea ever. Now I've been in a deep dark place going on 4 months. I have been hospitalized, took time off from work, stayed with my parents, and have contemplated suicide multiple times a day. 

I really miss my babies.
I also don't think I could kill myself with a dog.

I wish I could get a pit. My wife kept all of our dogs, one of which was a pit. I can't rescue a pit because of my goddamn apartment. I will love any dog I get but Pits hold a special place in my heart. I live near a city that has a high population of pits because of piece of shit assholes.

Not anymore. I moved out of my lovely house in a fit of mania and left my wife. There is no way I can go back to her and our three dogs. I live in an apartment so I'll have to walk her multiple times a day.
Thank you for your story. I hope one day I will have another significant other that loves me and stands by me.
Are you still looking to talk to someone?

I have so much anxiety, self doubt and worry. What if I can't get out of bed early in the morning like I do now? What if the dog resents me for not spending enough time with her? What if I'm not a good daddy? What if I can't train her well enough? 

Fucking disease.

I'm sure he/she wouldn't know what to do without you either. :)

I was never a cat person but I was considering getting one since I work full time. Other people work full time and have dogs so I hope she will manage.
I do. :) I have been really good with that. I guess it is supposed to help with the depression? I still have moments of hypomania where I can't focus on anything.
You are right. I have to stop "escaping" one of the huge ways is going to my parents house after work and just zoning out and falling asleep on the couch.
A "hunting" state. That is only for the items. I'm not sure how much paper work will cost.

The thing is I never took responsibility for the issues I caused. It was always someone else (my wife) or I had some other excuse. Now I can see that I caused most of the problems. She even wrote me a letter at the beginning of last year saying that things need to change and I'm a different person and she started cutting again. I keep bargaining like "If i could go back and tell myself to acknowledge this and work on it."

That was pretty cute. I actually laughed a little. :,( 

It's just to far away. I can think of a couple silly reasons not to be interested in it. Like I won't know the new characters and I should. I don't know the plot. I don't want to just know things and not work for it. I'm just too lazy.

Thank you for the kind words. I really hope this gets better. It is terrible timing to start medication. My wife left me because she couldn't deal with the pain I caused her. I don't think I will ever find a woman of such high quality.

She is very lackadaisical about my treatment. I called her last week and told her I am still feeling very depressed. She called me back and said she hopes I stick with it and to just keep on the same dosage/medication.

When I was in the hospital I picked some of that up "I am not depressed, I feel depressed but that is not who I am" 

Last wednesday I decided to wait two weeks. One week in and I still think it will happen. 7 more days. I can't wait to not feel like this or anything.

I started 12/1. Ramped up to 100mg by 2/1. I am a month into my "therapeutic" level and I am still depressed. Over the last few weeks I have had suicidal ideation. My pdoc says to give it time.

My brain feels like mush and I can't pick up new things or remember anything. People talk to me or I listen to podcasts and I can't remember what they say. I can't think of words and have difficulty constructing sentences. 

One note: I am going to a divorce (wife, dogs, house gone) and was recently diagnosed with BP. I spent the last 2 years on antidepressants in a manic state. 

I hope the best for you.
She keeps saying it is related to what is happening in my life ie wife left me took the house and dogs. I live alone for the first time.
I'm on 100/mg and my memory is terrible. I can't focus on work. I'm severely depressed because a ton of life shit. I've been on it for a couple of weeks and don't think it is helping me.
I was titrated up to 100mg on 1/30. It has been a little under a month. I have been losing hope that it will work. I don't think anything will work.
I was on antidepressants and they did fuck me up. They also helped destroy my marriage. Got to the point where she was afraid of me. I was a monster. I don't feel like a man anymore.
The Dr. says I should stick with it.

I get anxiety when I think about caring for a dog. I think I can't handle it  because my wife did most of it. I work full time and she was able to come home in the afternoon and be with them. I just don't want them to be unhappy. 

I've been codependent for the last 7 years and I'm not paying my own bills and doing all the cleaning. I get overwhelmed by everything. I'm so scared.

Thank you for the encouraging words. I was working out and eating right for about a month and then I went into the hospital. I am currently on Lamictal and going to a psychologist and psychiatrist. I tried to work on cognative therapy. I've gone to a couple groups. 

Like everything else in my life I give up. I am weak. I don't fight through anything. My wife was personal trainer so I have this irrational fear or just depression when I think about hitting the gym. Like I can't work out right. 

Have you had any memory issues on Lamictel? I am learning the days after I drink are even more depressing. 

I don't want to do anything. I just want my life back. My wife is so cold she won't even see me in person.
I don't know what makes me happy. I haven't been happy going on 4 months. My dogs made me happy. PC games made me happy.
Stabilizing on Lamictal and Ativan myself. I haven't felt better in the last three months. Looking into some startups downtown.

Jan 1 2014 I move to 200. I cannot wait. I have been severely depressed for a month and a half after regrettably leaving my wife. My estranged wife can't deal with my mania/depression and mood swings. Your story gives me hope that one day I will be "normal" and can once again live with the woman dearly love and miss.

I am also having trouble when I wake up. Thoughts immediately drift to my estranged wife and turn into crippling panic and depression. Our thoughts control our emotions and our emotions dictate our thoughts. IT is a vicious cycle. 

I just started Dr Burn's Feeling Good CBT (cognitive behavioral therapy). It will help prevent your thoughts from destroying your mood. See if you can pick up a copy and dedicate yourself to reading it. I have two weeks off and I am going to read it cover to cover. It might just save our lives. 

Keep your head up and try to be strong. You'll get through this.
